auth.second_factor_invalid: The code is wrong or was used already.
auth.second_factor_expired: The sign-in has expired. Please sign in with your password again.
auth.second_factor_required: Please enter a current code from your authenticator app.
auth.second_factor_locked: After too many wrong codes, two-factor sign-in is locked for an hour.

totp.no_password: Two-factor sign-in is only for accounts with a password.
totp.no_secret_key: Two-factor sign-in is not available on this installation (no secret key set).

signIn.title: Second factor
signIn.hint: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
signIn.useCode: Use a code from the app

profile.title: Two-factor sign-in
profile.description: With a second factor, signing in also needs a code from an authenticator app (TOTP). Optional.
profile.noPassword: Your account signs in through a provider; its two-factor sign-in applies there.
profile.noSecretKey: Not available on this installation: the operators set no secret key.

setup.title: Set up two-factor sign-in
setup.scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app or type the key by hand. It is shown only now.
setup.qr: QR code for the authenticator app
setup.codeHint: Enter the code the app shows now; only then is the second factor on.
setup.done: Two-factor sign-in is on. Your other sessions were ended.

codes.title: Recovery codes
codes.hint: Keep these codes safe (in your password manager, say). Each works once when you do not have your device. They are shown only now.

disable.title: Turn two-factor sign-in off?
disable.hint: Confirm with a current code or a recovery code. Afterwards you sign in with the password alone.

renew.title: New recovery codes
renew.hint: The previous codes stop working. Confirm with a current code from the app.

admin.resetText: Only when you are sure it really is {{name}} asking (in person, say, or through a known call-back). Afterwards the person signs in with the password alone until they set up the second factor again. This is audited.

token.codeHint: A new token needs your second factor.

activity.totpLocked: After ten wrong codes your two-factor sign-in is locked for an hour. If that was not you, someone may know your password: change it.
